summary: GridAI Technologies Corp. filed a Form 8-K on September 11, 2026, reporting that on September 4, 2026 it amended and restated its Secured Convertible Promissory Note with Pronghorn Resources, LLC to reflect a second loan of $964,000, bringing the aggregate principal to approximately $2,964,000. The parties also amended the related Security Agreement to update the note definition. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated. Watch for conversion dilution and collateral terms.
